# gcxtras_processautomation_scheduled_trigger (Resource)

Manages a Genesys Cloud Process Automation Scheduled Trigger.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gcxtras_processautomation_scheduled_trigger" "example" {
  name        = "Daily Report Generator"
  description = "Runs the daily report workflow every weekday at 9:00 AM"
  enabled     = true

  target {
    id   = "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890"
    type = "Workflow"
  }

  schedule {
    minutes       = [0]
    hours         = [9]
    days_of_week  = [2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
    timezone      = "Europe/London"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the scheduled trigger. Maximum 162 characters.
- `schedule` (Block List, Min: 1, Max: 1) The cron-based schedule configuration for the trigger. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--schedule))
- `target` (Block List, Min: 1, Max: 1) The target workflow to invoke when the trigger fires. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--target))

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the scheduled trigger. Maximum 512 characters.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the scheduled trigger is enabled.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--schedule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedule`

Required:

- `hours` (List of Number) The hours at which the trigger runs (0-23). Use `["*"]` for every hour. Specify as integers.
- `minutes` (List of Number) The minutes at which the trigger runs (0-59). Maximum of 2 values per hour.
- `timezone` (String) The timezone for the schedule (e.g. `Europe/London`, `America/New_York`, `UTC`).

Optional:

- `days_of_month` (List of Number) The days of the month on which the trigger runs (1-31). Leave empty or omit for every day.
- `days_of_week` (List of Number) The days of the week on which the trigger runs (1-7, starting with Sunday=1). Leave empty or omit for every day.
- `months` (List of Number) The months in which the trigger runs (1-12). Leave empty or omit for every month.


<a id="nestedblock--target"></a>
### Nested Schema for `target`

Required:

- `id` (String) The ID of the Architect workflow to invoke.
- `type` (String) The type of target. Must be `Workflow`.
